meta.notes: Six leather round a stick make the glider. A vanilla pack cannot add an item, so it is a phantom membrane carrying vanilla components: minecraft:glider and minecraft:equippable (the chest slot, the equipment asset msm_examples:leaf_glider_wings and the elytra's sound) let it glide as an elytra does, minecraft:max_damage gives 300 seconds of gliding, minecraft:repairable lets leather repair it in an anvil, and minecraft:item_model and minecraft:item_name give its look and name. Wear it, jump from somewhere high and press jump in the air to glide; firework rockets speed it up.
